title: Text that makes room for a shape you drag
blurb: A worm drawn by the canvas reaches into a page of text. Drag its head and the paragraphs re-flow round it on every frame. The browser does the line breaking: the page only rewrites one shape-outside polygon.
question: If something the canvas draws moves through a paragraph, can the browser lay the text out again round it on every frame, and what does a layout a frame cost?
result: Yes, on one side of the shape. A float with a shape-outside polygon that's rewritten each frame moves the lines, the picture in the next paint event has the new layout, and a link is hit at its new place. Text on both sides of the shape isn't possible with a float.
